variants.form_note: h33-h33-2-b2; MASS shadowcont-drop 20% -> 30123 dots, all >=1km strands kept; predicted +0.009 MODEL

mechanism_card.hypothesis: Deleting the 20% lowest-exclusive-credit dots of R0 under a rule that forbids splitting any >= 1 km kernel-continuous strand keeps the shadow ladder's mass saving while preserving the along-strike coverage line-like truth is paid for, so live DTI should match or beat the unconstrained shadow arm at the same count.
mechanism_card.mechanism: DTI = T / (0.2T + 0.2(S-M) + 0.8|G|) charges 0.2 per dot but credits T once per truth pixel (max over dots inside the 300 m triangular kernel). The shadow ranking removes dots whose disks neighbours already cover -- but those are disproportionately the interior dots of densely sampled strands, so at 40% it keeps 0 of R0's 838 strands of >= 10 dots at 5 px linking and pushes mean spacing to 6.19 px, beyond the kernel. For line-like truth the brief's own algebra lowers the per-dot bar (a dot pays iff its credit exceeds ~0.2*DTI, less for lines), so a strand sampled every ~5-6 px still covers every truth pixel while paying roughly half the mass of R0's ~2.8-3 px sampling. This arm keeps the identical credit ranking and dose, but a dot inside an R0 strand of >= 10 dots linked at <= 6 px (kernel diameter: linked disks touch) is ineligible while it is an articulation point of the strand or the strand is at its 10-dot floor. All 857 strands survive whole at 6 px; the measured price is +2.7% exclusive credit vs the unconstrained arm at matched count (E=38676 vs 37665).
mechanism_card.non_fault_confounder: Continuity is geometric, not geological: unfaulted dikes, resistant stratigraphic hogbacks, drainage divides and Lake Lahontan shoreline berms also form >= 1 km corridors in the H19-5 support, and protection preserves their mass with the same force as a real fault's. Conversely the dots protection forces out instead -- short fragments and isolated dots -- may be the sole coverage of short genuine strands (relay tips, step-over splays shorter than 1 km). A negative receipt cannot by itself separate 'strands were non-fault lineaments' from 'short fragments were real'.
mechanism_card.competing_prediction: The credit model alone ranks this arm strictly below its unconstrained twin: it destroys +2.7% more exclusive credit at the same count, hence the point prediction is scaled down to +0.009 from the shadow arm's +0.009 (both MODEL). The structural reading points the other way: on the legacy 5 px instrument this arm keeps 196 strands of >= 10 dots (unconstrained shadow keeps 0 at 40%, random keeps 136) and on the 6 px kernel-continuity instrument it keeps all 857 strands connected. If new-fault truth is line-like, the continuity term can outweigh a single-digit credit penalty; if truth is effectively point-like at 100 m sampling, it cannot. Both readings are recorded before any receipt; |delta| < 0.010 on public chunks is no evidence either way.
mechanism_card.predicted_live_change: +0.009 DTI (MODEL; bracket +0.001 to +0.048; not a score)
mechanism_card.model_bracket: first-order bracket +0.0009 to +0.0480 DTI over removed-dot credit c in [0.15, 0.45] and truth pixels in [20000, 100000] (src/mass.predicted_removal_delta); point = recorded shadow point scaled by the matched-count credit ratio. Assumptions, not measurements.
mechanism_card.falsifier: Paired same-week live receipts decide, with |delta| < 0.010 = no evidence throughout: (i) delta vs R0 <= -0.010 falsifies the dose direction for the protected ranking; (ii) at matched count, shadowcont minus shadow >= +0.010 shows continuity pays beyond credit and the protected ranking replaces the ladder; shadowcont minus shadow <= -0.010 shows the credit term is all there is and protection is abandoned; (iii) if the credit-blind random-40 control beats both ranked arms by >= 0.010, every exclusive-credit ranking in this repo is wrong, not just this one.
mechanism_card.structural_geologist_note: Map the survivors, not just the deletions. By construction every >= 1 km R0 strand remains a single kernel-continuous trace (gaps <= 600 m); what left is strand-interior redundancy, short < 1 km fragments and isolated dots. Where a surviving strand follows a mappable range-front or a step-over between catalogue traces, the protection did geological work; where it follows a shoreline, a contact or a drainage divide for kilometres, it preserved false mass and a negative receipt should be believed. Check also the deleted short fragments at fault tips: if they systematically sit in 0.3-2.5 km along-strike cones ahead of mapped terminations, the 10-dot floor is mis-set for relay geometry, which is a different (unbuilt) axis.

hard_constraint_note: Brief s4 asks >= 3 px from the catalogue unless AXIS=PRUNE. R0's own minimum is 2.236 px (1,611 dots, IR90-01/IR90-07); these deletion-only variants inherit that collar unchanged (moving it would be a second axis), add no mass at all, and emit zero catalogue mass. The gate enforced is no_new_mass_within_3px + subset_of_R0_no_additions_no_moves, as in every prior MASS session.
